<style>
/* ================================================================
   CV Page — Screen Styles
   ================================================================ */

.cv-page {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: 2rem auto;
  padding: 0 1rem;
  font-family: 'Lora', Georgia, serif;
  color: #2c3e50;
}

/* ---- Toolbar (download button) ---- */
.cv-toolbar {
  text-align: right;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.cv-print-btn {
  background: #18bc9c;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.45rem 1.2rem;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-block;
}

.cv-print-btn:hover {
  background: #149a80;
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* ---- CV Card ---- */
.cv-card {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e8edf1;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(44, 62, 80, 0.07);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
}

/* ---- Header ---- */
.cv-head {
  text-align: center;
  padding-bottom: 1.4rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #18bc9c;
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
}

.cv-name {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 2.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2c3e50;
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem 0;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.cv-name span {
  color: #18bc9c;
}

.cv-tagline {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #6c757d;
  margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.cv-contacts {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3rem 1.4rem;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #5a6472;
}

.cv-contacts a {
  color: #5a6472;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.cv-contacts a:hover {
  color: #18bc9c;
}

.cv-contact-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.cv-contact-item svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: #18bc9c;
}

/* ---- Section Titles ---- */
.cv-section-title {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: #18bc9c;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e8edf1;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin: 1.8rem 0 1rem 0;
}

/* ---- Profile ---- */
.cv-profile {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #3a4550;
}

/* ---- Skills ---- */
.cv-skills-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.cv-skills-list li {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  padding: 0.15rem 0;
  color: #3a4550;
}

.cv-skills-list li::before {
  content: "▸ ";
  color: #18bc9c;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.cv-skill-label {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #2c3e50;
}

/* ---- Entry (job / education / publication) ---- */
.cv-entry {
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
  page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.cv-entry-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f3f5;
  padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.cv-entry-left {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0 0.4rem;
}

.cv-entry-title {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #2c3e50;
}

.cv-entry-org {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #6c757d;
}

.cv-entry-date {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #18bc9c;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cv-entry ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #3a4550;
}

.cv-entry ul li {
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.cv-entry p {
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #3a4550;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0 0;
}

/* Pub link */
.cv-entry a.cv-pub-link {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #18bc9c;
}

/* ================================================================
   Print Styles — strip Quarto chrome, clean A4 page
   ================================================================ */
@media print {

  /* Hide all site chrome */
  #quarto-header,
  .navbar,
  #quarto-sidebar,
  #quarto-sidebar-glass,
  .quarto-secondary-nav,
  #quarto-margin-sidebar,
  footer.footer,
  .nav-footer,
  .cv-toolbar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Reset layout containers */
  body {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  #quarto-content,
  .page-columns,
  #quarto-document-content,
  main {
    display: block !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    grid-template-columns: unset !important;
  }

  /* CV page fills the paper */
  .cv-page {
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .cv-card {
    box-shadow: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
  }

  /* Page setup */
  @page {
    size: A4;
    margin: 1.4cm 1.6cm 1.4cm 1.6cm;
  }

  /* Avoid awkward page breaks */
  .cv-entry {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
  }

  .cv-section-title {
    page-break-after: avoid;
  }

  .cv-head {
    page-break-after: avoid;
  }

  /* Suppress URL printing after links */
  a[href]::after {
    content: none !important;
  }

  /* Slightly tighten for print */
  .cv-card {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .cv-name {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }
}
</style>
